notes.purpose: Independent re-run of the canonical §11.7 result on a fresh Colab session ~7 hours after the original. Trained metrics are identical to four decimals (judge mean +0.0792, rubric mean +0.0724, both 3-seed agreement) — actual evidence of seed-determinism across sessions. Lower peak VRAM (18.9 GB vs 35.6 GB) is because CROSS_FAMILY_JUDGE_MODEL was left at None; no second judge model was loaded.
notes.supports_whitepaper_claim: §11.7 'How to reproduce': set_all_seeds() + pinned commit + same trainee/judge produces bitwise-equal trained_metrics across independent Colab sessions. Wall-clock varies (4-20s per seed) due to A100 allocation differences but trained_metrics do not.
